services.name: Day Fun Trips
services.desc: Narrated 90-minute sightseeing cruise of Tampa Bay with music, commentary, and wildlife viewing. A fun way to see parts of the downtown waterway!

services.name: Sunset Trip
services.desc: General Admission (ages 13+): $25 Children (ages 3 - 12 yrs old): $12 Children (2 and under are FREE but must be on the reservation to board the boat) 1 1/2 hours About Our captain and crew will take you on a 90 minute trip around the waters of downtown Tampa while you kick back to your favorite tunes. Once the sun goes down, enjoy the beautiful Tampa Riverwalk along a portion of the Hillsborough River. We offer FREE bottled water on our cruises! We have no control over a perfect sunset but the sun will go down while you're on the Please arrive 20 minutes prior to departure. We do not refund or rebook if you miss the boat.

services.name: Holiday Lights
services.desc: A 1 hour holiday evening cruise along the Tampa River with narration and festive music. 1 Hour • All Ages
